summary: Camberwell (Melbourne) accounting and advisory firm est. 1952, an AFR Top 100 firm led by Managing Director Sevan Tuna, who also hosts the podcast The Bottom Line. It runs a bookkeeping division offering bank reconciliation and outsourced CFO services on Xero, QuickBooks and MYOB, with staff offshore in the Philippines and Malaysia. First email sent 23 Nov 2026; two follow-ups drafted.

hooks.text: Sevan hosts The Bottom Line podcast and leads a firm growing to the AFR top 100; growth means bookkeeping capacity pressure.
Bookkeeping division sells bank reconciliation and outsourced CFO on three ledgers (Xero, QuickBooks, MYOB).
Offshore staff in the Philippines and Malaysia suggest the firm already scales through labour; Vert is a different lever.

risks.text: Firm already uses offshore teams for volume work, which may reduce urgency.
LinkedIn shows headcount down 7.3% YoY; may be cost-conscious or restructuring.

gaps: No hiring ads found for bookkeepers in the last 12 months.
No evidence of the firm's reconciliation or AI tooling (Dext, Hubdoc, Karbon etc.).
